title: Add Tessera Lumen to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Tessera Lumen](https://app.963.co.za) to writing
- This app uses a backend proxy integration with Pollinations.ai. **Pollinations endpoint used** - https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions **Repository evidence** - POLLINATIONS.md : https://git

Fixes #13124

gist.headline: A new light for drafts
gist.blurb: Tessera Lumen has joined the writing garden, using Pollinations chat through a backend proxy. Another small tool for turning blank pages into somewhere to start.
gist.summary: Added Tessera Lumen, a writing app that integrates Pollinations through a backend proxy to the https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions endpoint, to the community app catalog.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations writing projects can now discover Tessera Lumen and its chat-powered drafting workflow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Tessera Lumen as a cozy writer's desk: a glowing retro terminal and an open manuscript illuminate a small garden of letter-shaped sprouts, representing chat-powered writing. Polli, wearing a tiny writer's beret, warmly tends the draft while a soft lamp symbolizes “Lumen” and the app's creative light.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of a warmly lit writer's desk where a retro terminal displays gentle chat bubbles beside an open manuscript, and letter-shaped code-plants grow from lime green (#ecf874) pots under a small pastel reading lamp. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny writer's beret and carefully waters the manuscript garden. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle pixel-font text: 'TESSERA LUMEN', nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
